For two factors (q+z,q-z) the generating polynomial changes by -z²(u-1)²: P(S=k)-P(S=k+2)=alpha_k z² for every feasible z. Rigidity gives alpha_k>0. Factorial ratios express alpha_k/c=(1+t)²B_k/[m(m-1)]. All symmetric mixed second derivatives are alpha_k, pure second derivatives zero, and sum_i v_i=0 gives isotropic alpha_k/2 eps² sum v_i². Derivative of binomial atom difference under common added h/m equals 2c/[mq(1-q)]>0, so IFT gives unique local compensating h and exact C=tB/[4(m-1)]. d_k~sqrt(k/8), binomial factorial expansion B_k=4+O(k^-1/2), yielding sqrt(k)C->2sqrt2. Independent binomial convolutions at k=1,2,5,24,80 match full-range pair identity and alpha formula; k=10^4,10^6 approach the large-k limit. Boundary k=0 is excluded precisely because Kleiner rigidity fails there.
